bio: It's not just the name that's Swedish (storstad, meaning big city, is a reference to the head chef's time in Stockholm); Nordic accents can also be detected in the design of the urban-chic restaurant on the fifth floor of the Turmtheater. Up here in the historical Goliath House, you can also make the most of the wonderful terrace with its views of the cathedral. Chef-patron Anton Schmaus can depend on his dedicated and talented kitchen team. Under the direction of head chef Josef Weig, the two set menus – one conventional and one vegetarian – each comprise five to seven courses, with a three-course option available Tuesday to Thursday.
